name: Murata
summary: Murata is an active Demon Slayer Corps swordsman who became friends with Tanjiro Kamado after fighting alongside him on Mount Natagumo. He is an experienced Demon Slayer capable of using Water Breathing and was the only survivor of the squad sent to Mount Natagumo. Despite being overshadowed by stronger Demon Slayers, Murata is a capable swordsman who successfully defended himself against numerous controlled Demon Slayers.

stats.attackPotency: Small Building level, higher with Constant Flux
stats.strikingStrength: Small Building level, higher with Constant Flux
stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

weaknesses: Murata's Water Breathing is so faint that it isn't visible to anyone
notes: Murata's Water Breathing includes the first ten forms, including Constant Flux, which progressively increases the strength of his strikes with each rotation due to momentum. His Total Concentration Breathing grants resistance to poison and allows him to slow the circulation of poison through his body. He fought at Mount Natagumo throughout the night and was the only survivor of his squad.
